method: Playwright Chromium headless-shell; pixel crops decoded with pngjs; zoom via 720x450 CSS px at dpr 2 (exact 200%-zoom geometry)
notes: Two first-run failures were measurement artifacts (viewport-only screenshot of below-fold elements; Playwright boundingBox has no .bottom), corrected by scroll-into-view recapture. Headless shell ignores --force-device-scale-factor, so zoom uses the exact-geometry context instead.
